<!-- The "Getting started" part of each release's notes (.github/workflows/release.yml); no heading of its own. -->
<!-- markdownlint-disable-file MD041 -->

Download the archive for your system, unpack it and start the program: the editor opens in your browser
(QUICKSTART.txt in the archive). It holds the engine and the editor of this release (nwn-landscaper-web, same tag).

The macOS build is signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple: the first start only asks whether to open a
program downloaded from the internet. The Windows build is not signed yet: if SmartScreen says it protected your PC,
More info, Run anyway. Check a download against SHA256SUMS.

Needs a legally obtained Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition install; ships none of its content. The source is
GPL-3.0-or-later and the binaries include Moonglow (GPL-3.0-only), so they are under GPL-3.0; the editor is MIT. The
complete source of the binaries, every dependency included, is `nwn-landscaper-*-source.tar.gz`. The full history is in
CHANGELOG.md.
